descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**You are the worst Tattoo Artist of all time!**

Tattoo clients - anywhere you want!  Clients will come in and have you tattoo THOUSANDS of designs!  It’s up to you to make them look good!  Your tattoo will be graded and ranked, and the customer will pay you based on how good you’ve done.

[media]

**😱 Tattoo ANYWHERE!😱**

You can tattoo anywhere on the body!  Use four different types of tattoo guns in order to bring your masterpiece to life.

[media]

**💥THROW your clients around!💥**

Is their positioning not optimal?  Throw them!  Grab your clients and hurl them wherever you’d like.  Is their position too messed up?  Don’t worry, you can always reset them!

[media]

**🙏Save your best designs!🙏**

Why let a masterpiece go to waste?  Save all your best designs so you can come back and view your best works!

[media]

**🤑Make Money!🤑**

With each tattoo, your skills are graded using AI!  Your clients will grade you based on whether or not you followed their request.

[media]

🗣️Chat Away!🗣️

Your clients are very chatty, listen to them talk all day!
